HelpSchemeHandler

class HelpSchemeHandler(parent=None)[source]

Bases: QWebEngineUrlSchemeHandler

Answer qthelp:// requests with data from a help engine.

Parameters:
parentQObject | None, optional

Owner of the handler. It must live as long as the web profile. Default is None.

Attributes:
SCHEMEbytes, class attribute

URL scheme served by this handler (b"qthelp").

_instanceHelpSchemeHandler | None, class attribute

Handler shared by every install call.

Methods

register_scheme()

Register the scheme. Call before creating the QApplication.

install(engine)

Serve the given help engine in the default web profile.

Methods

install

Serve engine through the default web profile.

register_scheme

Register the qthelp scheme in Qt WebEngine.

requestStarted

Reply to a request with the file stored in the help engine.
static register_scheme()[source]

Register the qthelp scheme in Qt WebEngine.

Qt requires both calls to happen before the QApplication is created.

Notes

Also sets Qt.AA_ShareOpenGLContexts. The scheme uses the host syntax and is flagged secure, local and allowed to access local content.

classmethod install(engine)[source]

Serve engine through the default web profile.

The handler is created once and reused; only the engine changes when the language changes.

Parameters:
engineQHelpEngineCore

Engine whose documentation will be served.

Returns:
HelpSchemeHandler

The shared handler.

requestStarted(job)[source]

Reply to a request with the file stored in the help engine.

Parameters:
jobQWebEngineUrlRequestJob

Request made by the web view.

Notes

The request fails with UrlNotFound when the engine has no data for the URL (or no engine is installed yet).
